title: fix(components, plugin-list, i18n): sort directions read by field type — size for numbers on the builder and the phone sheet
body:
repo:objectstack#4 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYnagJvGbCtNg2PhvgW

Fixes #37027

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读
- 列表「全部排序层级」和手机上的排序面板里,数字、百分比、进度、金额、布尔字段的方向选项从「A → Z / Z → A」改为「小 → 大 / 大 → 小」;日期与时间仍按「最早 → 最新」,文本仍按字母序;阿拉伯语的字母序方向不再显示反了。
- 列表页重做专题的里程碑验收发现的显示错误,让排序方向的说法与字段类型一致。
- 出错时只是方向文字不对,排序结果本身不变;可直接撤回。
- 无

## What changes
- `SortBuilder` (`ui/packages/components/src/custom/sort-builder.tsx`) had its own direction table that knew only `date` / `datetime`, so every other type read "A → Z". It now words a level by a module-local `sortWording` + `sortDirectionLabel` (no new package export): date-like types (`FILTER_DATE_LIKE_TYPES`: date, datetime, time) read as time, the spec's numeric family (`FILTER_NUMBER_LIKE_TYPES`: number, currency, percent, rating, slider, progress, summary) plus boolean as size, anything else as the alphabet, over the `listConditions.sort.{time,size,alphabet}_{asc,desc}` rows every locale already carries. No i18n key is added.
- The phone sort sheet's levels (`ui/packages/plugin-list/src/phone/PhoneListPanels.tsx`) had the same date-only table over `sortBuilder.*` keys. They now read `sortDirectionLabel` from `plugin-list`'s `conditions/conditionModel.ts` (an internal module, not a package export), with the same rule and the same keys. The list's former `sortWording` / `ListConditionControls.sortDirectionLabel` pair, which had no non-test caller, is folded into that helper.
- Trade-off, stated: the rule lives twice, module-local in `@object-ui/components` and in `plugin-list`'s condition model, over the same `@object-ui/types` lists and the same locale rows; each copy carries a comment pointing at its twin. One copy would need a new published export from `@object-ui/components` or `@object-ui/types`, which would make this `Clause-②: yes (widening)`. Both copies are pinned for number, progress, percent, currency, boolean, time, date and text, so the two cannot drift apart unnoticed.
- `@object-ui/i18n`, Arabic: `listConditions.sort.alphabet_asc` / `alphabet_desc` read "A ← Z" / "Z ← A". A run of two Latin letters stays left to right on a right-to-left page, so ascending displayed as Z to A; this PR is the first to show those rows, so they now read "A → Z" / "Z → A". The key set is unchanged.
- The four `sortBuilder.ascending/descending/oldestFirst/newestFirst` rows are no longer read by either surface (`plugin-list`'s provider-less defaults drop them). The locale rows stay in the published packs: removing them would be a narrowing. A host that overrode them now overrides `listConditions.sort.*`.
- Visible wording that moves with the source rows: Japanese and Korean dates read 「古い → 新しい」 / 「오래된 순 → 최신 순」 (were 「古い順」 / 「오래된 순」), Russian dates "Старые → Новые" (was "Сначала старые") and Russian text "А → Я" (was "A → Z").
- `origin/main` merged in (merge commit 597bdd4f9).

## Tests
- `ui/packages/components/src/__tests__/sort-builder-date-direction-duplicates-27520.test.tsx`: number, progress, percent and currency rows offer "Low → High" / "High → Low"; boolean reads as size and time as time; CONTROL: date keeps time and text keeps the alphabet. Under the real `I18nProvider`: zh number and progress rows read 「小 → 大」 / 「大 → 小」, and ar text rows read "A → Z" / "Z → A". These replace the removed plugin-list unit test of the dead helper.
- `ui/packages/plugin-list/src/__tests__/ListView.phonePanels-35884.test.tsx`, on the real phone `ListView`: number, progress, percent, currency and boolean levels read "Low → High", a time level reads as time; CONTROL: date as time, text as the alphabet.

## Acceptance notes
- Browser check, showcase app, zh-CN, `showcase_task` (Console from `ui/` source via Vite against a private backend): desktop sort builder options for `estimate_hours` and `progress` read `["小 → 大","大 → 小"]` and `due_date` reads `["最早 → 最新","最新 → 最早"]`. At phone width (390 px), a new `estimate_hours` or `progress` level reads 「小 → 大」.
